basic_info.description: Chic and generous 1BR/1BA condo blocks from Hayes Valley in doorperson building. This modern home features floor-to-ceiling windows, high ceilings, and beautiful hardwood floors. The open layout includes a bright living area with city outlooks and a sleek open kitchen with gas range, pantry, and breakfast bar flowing into a large dining spaceideal for entertaining. The bedroom offers a walk-in closet, along with additional in-unit closets. The bathroom boasts a clean, modern design with a shower over an oversized soaking tub. Enjoy the convenience of in-unit laundry, two extra storage units (one on the same floor), and deeded parking. Pet-friendly building includes concierge, fitness center, and rooftop deck. Located steps from Hayes Valley dining, shops, and cultural landmarks like SF Jazz Center and the Ballet, with easy access to public transportation. A stylish urban retreat in one of the city's most dynamic neighborhoods.
